item.title: Short E Words Worksheets for Kindergarten and 1st grade: Read, Trace, Write and Sort (Printable)
item.description: Printable short e CVC word worksheets for kindergarten and 1st grade. Each page has a word bank to read out loud, big outline words to trace, a row to write three words, and a mixed list of words where your child circles short e or short i. No prep, with an answer key, in color and in black and white.

item.title: CVC Cut and Paste Worksheets: Missing Beginning, Middle and Ending Sounds (Kindergarten)
item.description: Printable CVC cut and paste worksheets for kindergarten phonics. Children look at the picture, say the word, then cut and glue the missing beginning, middle or ending sound. Twelve no prep pages with an answer key, in color and in black and white. Great for phonics centers.

No prep, with an answer key, in color and in black and white.
